title: Taste of History and Tapas
text: Leo was very personable and provided a custom experience with knowledge and insight on history and the area. We had great tapas, drinks and conversation.
author: 606nanettep

title: Great intro to Granada’s food culture 👍🏻
text: Knowledgeable tour guide with a relaxed style who took us to some great spots we’d never have found otherwise. Leo explains a lot of local history as you walk between the food spots, so you take in a lot!
author: Tour41411835636

title: Lovely evening
text: Lovely evening with Leo. He took us to some very cool places and gave us some great insights into Granada. We all really enjoyed the evening 😊
author: colmr_13

title: Leo is a great guide
text: Leo was a great guide - giving us some history of Granada and talking us through the tapas and the wine/drinks in this area. He took us to bars that we were unlikely to have found on our own for a few tapas with our drinks.
author: Lizzy C

title: Bibulous Granada Tapas!
text: Fun. Lively. Entertaining. Engaging. Historically informative. Dynamic. Delicious. Bibulous! Welcoming. Inclusive.
author: Global817756

title: Great experience
text: We got to taste a few classic, very good tapas and learned about the city and its culture at the same time. Leo is very knowledgable and easy going, fun to be around. He showed us a few cool corners we would otherwise not have discovered ourselves. 10/10, would recommend!
author: joycewS6233LU

title: Personalized and fun!
text: Really enjoyed our experience with Leo! He is informative, friendly, and engages with what is most interesting to you. He did a great job making it fun for my teenage boys.
author: Southernsobos

title: Great times and tapas with Leo!
text: Had a blast with Leo. He was very friendly and knowledgeable. Outstanding tapas and some really cool old bars we visited. I highly recommend!
author: James_S

title: Our favorite tour of Granada
text: Leo was fabulous. He was gracious with input about the food, culture, and history of Granada. It was a great way to try things we would not have found on our own. It helped us feel more at home with bars and taverns of Granada that we would not have had on our own. Would definitely book again.
author: J1281KCandrews

title: Great experience!
text: Leo is an excellent guide who knows the area bars with great tapas very well. His knowledge of local history is also impressive, and he's well traveled. I'll do the tour with him again the next time I'm in Granada!
author: GVolk
